name: band vertical pallof press
description: A vertical Pallof press with a band, pressing at chest height and holding. It trains the core to resist rotation.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on to it, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with both hands at the middle of your chest, with tension on it.
Brace your core and press your hands straight up overhead.
Hold briefly without letting your body turn toward the anchor.
Bring your hands back to your chest, finish the reps, then switch sides.
